    • CurseView

      public CurseView(Hero hero, Item curse, FightGraphics fight, ImageLoader imageHero, ImageLoader imagesItems, int refuseCount)
      Create a curse view for the hero. Shows the curse and lets the hero accept or refuse it.
      Parameters:
      hero - the hero
      curse - the curse item to offer
      fight - the current fight state
      imageHero - the hero images
      imagesItems - the item images
      refuseCount - number of times the hero can refuse
